items.title: TJX earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- The TJX Companies, Inc (TJX) closed at $140.30 (+8.05%) on Nov 18, 3:59 PM EST. Pre-market on Nov 19 at 9:22 AM EST it was $140.60. The jump came despite a thin EPS beat, so the market was reacting to relief more than to upside. Q3 FY2027 EPS of $1.34 only matched the estimate. Revenue of $15.95B beat the $15.82B estimate. Comparable sales rose 4%, which was above plan.
